Hi Maria! Lovely to see you. How was your week?
Hi! It was busy. I had a big meeting with a client on Thursday.
Quite good, I think. We need to push back the deadline, and they was not happy at first.
They were not happy. Were, because they is plural. So how did you convince them?
They were not happy. I said, if you give us one more week, we will deliver a better product.
Perfect, that's a great conditional. Today let's practise negotiating. A useful phrase is to meet halfway. It means to compromise.
To meet halfway. So, if you pay half the cost, we can meet halfway?
Exactly. And another one: leeway. Leeway is extra time or freedom.
We don't have much leeway on the budget this quarter.
Brilliant. Let's try a role play. I'm the supplier, and I can't change the delivery date.
I understand, but could we find a solution? Maybe we can meet halfway on the price.
Very natural, Maria. For homework, write a short email asking a supplier to push back a deadline.
